title: Standardized JSON Backups
notes: Standardizes manually saved Drill Log and Shot Diagram JSON files under one documented MITHRIL backup format.
Adds explicit document type, template identity, schema version, document-contract version, creation time, source MITHRIL version, title, and complete document state.
Keeps older Drill Log and Shot Diagram backups loadable through backward-compatible legacy detection.
Keeps new backups readable by older rollback versions by preserving the legacy top-level pages, header, page-position, view, shot-info, and Drill Log calibration fields.
Prevents a Drill Log backup from being restored into the Shot Diagram, and vice versa, with a clear instruction to open the correct tool.
Includes standardized JSON when the Drill Log creates its PDF and JSON sharing package.
